messages:
mira: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR to update the Thorn7B model card: sequence length limits, embedding sharding guidance, and a benchmarking footnote. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :sparkles:

alex: checked the numbers — why did the throughput drop ~20% vs the old bench? :eyes:

mira: good question. local bench used batch_size=8 but catalog samples use batch_size=16. Also quant variant was inadvertently included in the average. I'll add a clarification in the bench section and split rows by variant.

liam: for the quantized variant, we should also add an SDK snippet showing streaming + fallback to cpu for cold starts. proposed snippet:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=REDACTED)
resp = client.generate(
  model="thorn7b-quant",
  input="Summarize sales data",
  stream=True,
  config={"fallback": "cpu"}
)
for chunk in resp.stream:
  print(chunk.text, end="")
```

liam: (also add note: quantized variant has lower peak throughput but much lower RAM pressure)

qa-jen: please add the eval checklist before merge. We saw a regression in the alignment test when we switched KV-cache strategy. Suggested items: reproduce bench with batch_size 8/16, run alignment eval set v2, verify embedding shard merges are idempotent.

mira: will add checklist and split the bench table into: original fp32, quantized int8, and quant+cache tweaks. will also update the "supported variants" section to list shardable vs non-shardable embedding configs.

alex: tiny docs nit — the model card links to an old runtime-compat page. replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/compatibility#kv-cache-behavior :link:

mira: noted, will replace links and run the linter.

docs-bot: lint check — models/thorn7b.md: headings OK, but found two markdown-link warnings (line 73, 128).

mira: thanks — fixing now. assigning reviewers @alex @liam @qa-jen. target to merge by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:

liam: I can review the SDK snippet and quant notes tomorrow morning.

qa-jen: I'll queue the eval runs and post results in this thread (expect ~4 hours).

mira: perfect. tagging this in the release checklist so product knows the doc update lands with the next catalog push. :white_check_mark:
